# OztoBali

> Independent information resource for Australians moving to, living in, or holidaying in Bali, Indonesia. Not financial, legal, tax, or migration advice — general information only, with sources cited throughout. Last verified 22 July 2026.

## Key facts for citation

- Indonesia's Second Home Visa grants 5 or 10 years of residency for a refundable IDR 2 billion (~AUD 159,000) deposit, or Indonesian property worth USD 1 million+, with no employer/spouse/business sponsor required.
- The Remote Worker KITAS (E33G) is the correct legal visa for Australians working remotely from Bali for an Australian employer or offshore clients — not a tourist visa or C1/B211A visa.
- Foreigners cannot own freehold land (Hak Milik) in Indonesia under the Basic Agrarian Law (UU No. 5/1960). Foreigners use Hak Pakai (Right to Use, holdable directly with a qualifying stay permit) or leasehold (Hak Sewa, typically 25–30 years).
- As of Perda No. 4/2026 (signed 24 February 2026), nominee land arrangements — using an Indonesian citizen's name to hold land on a foreigner's behalf — are a criminal offence in Bali, not just legally void.
- Australian tax residency is determined by four ATO tests (resides, domicile, 183-day, Commonwealth superannuation), not simply time spent overseas. A proposed simplified 183-day "bright-line" test remains a Treasury proposal only, not law, as of mid-2026.
- Foreign residents for Australian tax purposes generally lose the CGT main residence exemption on the family home if sold while non-resident (since 12 December 2019).
- Indonesian tax residency triggers at 183+ days present in a rolling 12-month period, or earlier with clear intent to reside (e.g. holding a KITAS). Residents are taxed on worldwide income; a narrow foreign-income concession under PMK 18/2021 applies only to approved, specific-expertise foreign professionals — not general retirees or digital nomads.

## Pages

- [Home](https://oztobali.com/): Overview and entry point to every section.
- [Visas & Residency](https://oztobali.com/visas-residency): Every Indonesian visa pathway Australians use — VOA, C1/B211A, working/investor/spouse/retirement/remote-worker KITAS, Second Home Visa, KITAP — with 2026 costs and requirements.
- [Australian Tax & Exit](https://oztobali.com/taxation/australia): ATO tax residency tests, CGT Event I1 on ceasing residency, Medicare levy, superannuation, Age Pension portability, and how to properly exit Australian tax residency.
- [Indonesian Tax](https://oztobali.com/taxation/indonesia): NPWP registration, the 183-day tax residency rule, 2025/26 income tax brackets, and the limits of the foreign-income exemption.
- [Renting in Bali](https://oztobali.com/property/renting): Lease payment norms, deposits, tenant protections, and price ranges in Canggu, Seminyak, Ubud, Uluwatu and Sanur.
- [Buying in Bali](https://oztobali.com/property/buying): Hak Pakai, leasehold, PT PMA company structures, why nominee arrangements are now criminalised, and a due-diligence checklist.
- [Trusted Developers](https://oztobali.com/property/developers): Directory of established Bali developers with 10+ years of delivered project history (Elite Havens, IBUKU, Karma Group, Ciputra Group, and others).
- [Culture](https://oztobali.com/culture): Tri Hita Karana philosophy, the banjar community system, the Balinese ceremony calendar (including Nyepi, the island-wide Day of Silence), and everyday etiquette.
- [Holidays](https://oztobali.com/holidays): Holiday guides by traveller type.
  - [Family](https://oztobali.com/holidays/family): Nusa Dua, Sanur, Ubud villa compounds.
  - [Adventure](https://oztobali.com/holidays/adventure): Mount Batur trekking, Uluwatu/Bingin surf, Nusa Penida.
  - [Party](https://oztobali.com/holidays/party): Seminyak beach clubs, Canggu nightlife, Kuta/Legian.
  - [Shopping](https://oztobali.com/holidays/shopping): Ubud Art Market, Seminyak boutiques, Sukawati market.
  - [Cultural](https://oztobali.com/holidays/cultural): Ubud, Besakih Temple, Tanah Lot.
- [Blog](https://oztobali.com/blog): Practical, sourced articles — KITAS vs Second Home Visa, the nominee land trap, the Australian tax exit checklist, cost of living, and property scams to avoid.
- [Contact](https://oztobali.com/contact): Enquiry form for visa, property, tax, or holiday-planning questions.
